snippet.title: Ashwood Valley | Announcement Trailer | Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Ashwood Valley – a new farming game with a magical twist is on the horizon! This pixel-themed story from the team of Tell Me Your Story and Cook for Love will appear this year on Nintendo Switch.

Here you will take on the role of a magical kid trying to save their sibling from being permanently transformed into a fluffy feline.


Don't forget to follow us on 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/RedDeer_Games
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/RedDeerGames
and Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/reddeer_games/
